WITH transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitNumber,
    visitStartTime,
    device.deviceCategory,
    h.transaction.transactionId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_transaction_date,
    MIN(visitStartTime) as first_transaction_time
  FROM transactions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction_session AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.deviceCategory
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN first_transaction ft 
    ON t.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId 
    AND t.date = ft.first_transaction_date
    AND t.visitStartTime = ft.first_transaction_time
)
SELECT 
  ft.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  fts.deviceCategory
FROM first_transaction ft
JOIN first_visit fv ON ft.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
JOIN first_transaction_session fts ON ft.fullVisitorId = fts.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

WITH 
-- First, find the top traffic source by total product revenue
top_source AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS total_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source
  ORDER BY total_product_revenue_millions DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Daily revenue per traffic source
daily_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    date,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS daily_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source, date
),
-- Weekly revenue per traffic source
weekly_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS weekly_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source, week_start
),
-- Monthly revenue per traffic source
monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS monthly_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source, month_start
)
SELECT 
  ts.traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(d.daily_product_revenue_millions) FROM daily_rev d WHERE d.traffic_source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(w.weekly_product_revenue_millions) FROM weekly_rev w WHERE w.traffic_source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(m.monthly_product_revenue_millions) FROM monthly_rev m WHERE m.traffic_source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions
FROM top_source ts

SELECT `_TABLE_SUFFIX`, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201704*`
WHERE `_TABLE_SUFFIX` BETWEEN '01' AND '30'
GROUP BY `_TABLE_SUFFIX`
ORDER BY `_TABLE_SUFFIX`
LIMIT 5

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
  AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
buyer_products AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_qty
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND p.productQuantity > 0
  AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(total_qty) AS grand_total_qty
FROM buyer_products
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY grand_total_qty DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.date,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', date) as date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2

WITH home_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.time,
    h.page.pagePath as homePagePath,
    LEAD(h.page.pagePath) OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) as nextPagePath,
    LEAD(h.time) OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) - h.time as timeOnHome
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
    AND h.type = 'PAGE'
    AND h.page.pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_pages AS (
  SELECT nextPagePath
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE nextPagePath IS NOT NULL
),
max_page AS (
  SELECT nextPagePath as mostCommonNextPage
  FROM next_pages
  GROUP BY nextPagePath
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(SAFE_CAST(timeOnHome / 1000 AS INT64)) as maxTimeSeconds
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE timeOnHome IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT mostCommonNextPage FROM max_page) as mostCommonNextPage,
  (SELECT maxTimeSeconds FROM max_time) as maxTimeSeconds

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  ROUND(MAX(monthly_revenue) - MIN(monthly_revenue), 2) / 1000000 as diff_millions
FROM monthly

SELECT p.v2ProductName as product_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.productQuantity, 1)) as total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
AND fullVisitorId IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) h2, UNNEST(h2.product) p2
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p2.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND h2.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
)
AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH 
-- Users with positive engagement time in the 7-day period (Jan 1-7, 2021)
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
-- Users with positive engagement time in the 2-day period (Jan 6-7, 2021)
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id
)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date, new_confirmed, 
         LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) as date_mmdd, new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) as growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(total_discharges * average_total_payments) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC

-- The route with the longest average bike duration among those faster than yellow taxis is:
-- 12 Ave & W 40 St -> West St & Chambers St with avg_bike_duration = 1483.91 seconds

-- The question asks for the start station name of this route.
-- Let me verify this is correct by getting just the top one

WITH top_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name, 
        end_station_name,
        ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lng,
        ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lng,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_durations AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lng,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lng,
        TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) as duration_seconds
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE trip_distance > 0
        AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
),
taxi_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng,
        AVG(duration_seconds) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM taxi_durations
    GROUP BY start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng
)
SELECT 
    tr.start_station_name,
    tr.end_station_name,
    tr.avg_bike_duration,
    ta.avg_taxi_duration
FROM top_routes tr
JOIN taxi_agg ta 
    ON tr.start_lat = ta.start_lat 
    AND tr.start_lng = ta.start_lng
    AND tr.end_lat = ta.end_lat
    AND tr.end_lng = ta.end_lng
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ta.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_seconds, 60) AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
    AND fare IS NOT NULL
),
trips_with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS max_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS average_fare
FROM trips_with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

WITH fec_donations AS (
  SELECT 
    c.census_tract_geoid,
    f.transaction_amt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` f
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` c
    ON f.zip_code = c.zip_code
  WHERE f.state = 'NY'
    AND f.transaction_amt > 0
    AND c.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
),
tract_donations AS (
  SELECT 
    census_tract_geoid,
    AVG(transaction_amt) as avg_donation,
    COUNT(*) as donation_count
  FROM fec_donations
  GROUP BY census_tract_geoid
),
kings_tracts AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
)
SELECT 
  k.geo_id AS census_tract_geoid,
  ROUND(COALESCE(d.avg_donation, 0), 2) AS avg_donation,
  k.median_income
FROM kings_tracts k
LEFT JOIN tract_donations d
  ON k.geo_id = d.census_tract_geoid
ORDER BY k.geo_id
LIMIT 15 OFFSET 746

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    c.condition_status_code,
    p.state_code,
    p.evaluation_description,
    SUM(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor) AS subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * p.expansion_factor) AS macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, c.condition_status_code, p.state_code, p.evaluation_description
  HAVING SUM(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor) > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC, evaluation_type ASC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group,
  evaluation_group_description,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  state_code,
  ROUND(macroplot_acres, 2) AS macroplot_acres,
  ROUND(subplot_acres, 2) AS subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH age_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code, 
    country_name, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN population ELSE 0 END) AS pop_under_20, 
    SUM(population) AS total_pop 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific` 
  WHERE year = 2020 
  GROUP BY country_code, country_name
),
mid_pop AS (
  SELECT country_code, country_name, midyear_population 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` 
  WHERE year = 2020
)
SELECT 
  a.country_name,
  a.pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(a.pop_under_20, m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM age_pop a
JOIN mid_pop m ON a.country_code = m.country_code
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH top_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    cumulative_confirmed,
    COALESCE(cumulative_recovered, 0) as cumulative_recovered,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_name ORDER BY COALESCE(cumulative_confirmed, 0) DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE date = DATE('2020-05-10') AND aggregation_level = 1
)
SELECT 
  country_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate_pct
FROM top_rows
WHERE rn = 1 AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS date_str,
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) AS date_val,
    ROUND((temp - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444, 1) AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' 
    AND year = '2019' 
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date_str,
    date_val,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date_val ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date_val ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date_val ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  date_str,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag1,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag1,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag1,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag2,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag2,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag2,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag3,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag3,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag3,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag4,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag4,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag4,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag5,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag5,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag5,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag6,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag6,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag6,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag7,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag7,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag7,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag8,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag8
FROM with_ma
WHERE date_val >= DATE('2019-01-09')
ORDER BY date_val

SELECT usa_latitude, usa_longitude, iso_time, usa_status
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND track_type = 'main' AND name = 'TEDDY'
ORDER BY iso_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT id, name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE (
  6371 * ACOS(
    SIN(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) +
    COS(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS((longitude - (-87.6847)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180)
  )
) <= 50
ORDER BY id

WITH trip_distances AS (
  SELECT
    t.bike_number,
    6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((s_end.latitude - s_start.latitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2), 2) +
      COS(s_start.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(s_end.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) *
      POWER(SIN((s_end.longitude - s_start.longitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2), 2)
    )) AS trip_distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_start

WITH same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id as station_id,
    starttime,
    CONCAT(
      CAST(DATE(starttime) AS STRING),
      ' ',
      CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) AS STRING),
      ':',
      CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) / 2) * 2 AS STRING)
    ) as two_min_bucket
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
group_buckets AS (
  SELECT station_id, two_min_bucket
  FROM same_station_trips
  GROUP BY station_id, two_min_bucket
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
group_rides_per_station AS (
  SELECT 
    s.station_id,
    COUNT(*) as group_rides
  FROM same_station_trips s
  INNER JOIN group_buckets g 
    ON s.station_id = g.station_id 
    AND s.two_min_bucket = g.two_min_bucket
  GROUP BY s.station_id
),
total_trips_per_station AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id as station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
)
SELECT 
  st.name as station_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_rides, t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_rides_per_station g
INNER JOIN total_trips_per_station t
  ON g.station_id = t.station_id
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` st
  ON CAST(g.station_id AS STRING) = st.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    t.fare_amount,
    tz.borough as pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_borough,
    CASE
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.05 THEN 'up to 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.10 THEN '5% to 10%'

      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      ELSE 'more than 25%'
    END as tip_category,
    total_amount
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  tip_category,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)) as proportion
FROM categorized
GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
ORDER BY pickup_borough, tip_category

WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT id, creation_date as user_created, DATE_TRUNC(creation_date, MONTH) as signup_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
-- Users who asked at least one question within 30 days of signup
users_asked_within_30 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id as user_id, u.user_created, u.signup_month
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON u.id = q.owner_user_id
  WHERE q.creation_date >= u.user_created
    AND q.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.user_created, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
),
-- For each user who asked within 30 days, find their ABSOLUTE first question date
user_first_q AS (
  SELECT 
    uaq.user_id,
    uaq.signup_month,
    MIN(q.creation_date) as first_question_date
  FROM users_asked_within_30 uaq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON uaq.user_id = q.owner_user_id
  WHERE q.creation_date >= uaq.user_created
  GROUP BY uaq.user_id, uaq.signup_month
),
-- Among those, check who answered at least one question after their first question and within 30 days of first question
users_answered_within_30_of_first AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uq.user_id, uq.signup_month
  FROM user_first_q uq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON uq.user_id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > uq.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(uq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', u21.signup_month) as month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u21.id) as total_new_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uaq.user_id) as users_asked_within_30,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT uaq.user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT u21.id)) * 100, 2) as pct_asked_within_30,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uaqf.user_id) as users_answered_within_30_of_first,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT uaqf.user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT uaq.user_id)) * 100, 2) as pct_answered_within_30_of_first
FROM users_2021 u21
LEFT JOIN users_asked_within_30 uaq ON u21.id = uaq.user_id
LEFT JOIN users_answered_within_30_of_first uaqf ON uaq.user_id = uaqf.user_id AND uaq.signup_month = uaqf.signup_month
GROUP BY u21.signup_month
ORDER BY u21.signup_month

WITH temps AS (
  SELECT year, mo, da, AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
    AND complaint_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY complaint_date
),
complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
    AND complaint_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY complaint_date, complaint_type
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.year, t.mo, t.da, t.avg_temp,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.daily_count,
    dt.total_daily_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.daily_count, dt.total_daily_complaints) * 100 as daily_pct
  FROM temps t
  LEFT JOIN complaints c 
    ON CAST(CONCAT(t.year, '-', t.mo, '-', t.da) AS DATE) = c.complaint_date
  LEFT JOIN daily_totals dt
    ON CAST(CONCAT(t.year, '-', t.mo, '-', t.da) AS DATE) = dt.complaint_date
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(daily_count) as total_complaints
  FROM joined
  WHERE daily_count IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
corr_data AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    ct.total_complaints,
    COUNT(j.avg_temp) as total_days,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_count) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_count)) * 1.0 /
    (SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.avg_temp, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2)) * 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.daily_count, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_count), 2)))) as corr_temp_count,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_pct) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_pct)) * 1.0 /
    (SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.avg_temp, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2)) * 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.daily_pct, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_pct), 2)))) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined j
  INNER JOIN complaint_totals ct ON j.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
  WHERE j.daily_count IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY j.complaint_type, ct.total_complaints
)
SELECT complaint_type, total_complaints, total_days, 
       ROUND(corr_temp_count, 4) as corr_temp_count,
       ROUND(corr_temp_pct, 4) as corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_data
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY complaint_type

WITH daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY complaint_date, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY complaint_date
),
daily_wind AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND wdsp IS NOT NULL
    AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.complaint_type,
    dc.complaint_date,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.type_count, dt.total_daily_count) as daily_proportion,
    dw.wdsp as wind_speed
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.complaint_date = dt.complaint_date
  JOIN daily_wind dw ON dc.complaint_date = dw.weather_date
  WHERE dw.wdsp IS NOT NULL
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(daily_proportion) as sum_p,
    SUM(wind_speed) as sum_w,
    SUM(daily_proportion * daily_proportion) as sum_p2,
    SUM(wind_speed * wind_speed) as sum_w2,
    SUM(daily_proportion * wind_speed) as sum_pw
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    SUM(type_count) as total_requests
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(type_count) > 3000
)
SELECT 
  c.complaint_type,
  c.n,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      c.n * c.sum_pw - c.sum_p * c.sum_w,
      SQRT((c.n * c.sum_p2 - c.sum_p * c.sum_p) * (c.n * c.sum_w2 - c.sum_w * c.sum_w))
    ),
    4
  ) as pearson_corr
FROM correlations c
JOIN total_counts t ON c.complaint_type = t.complaint_type
WHERE c.complaint_type IN ('HEAT/HOT WATER', 'Outdoor Dining')

  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
counts_2015 AS (

  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''

SELECT

  COALESCE(c15.dead_count, 0) - COALESCE(c19.dead_count, 0) AS dead_growth
FROM counts_1995 c19

-- Full proportional allocation query with rounding
WITH zip_5mi AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'WA'
  AND ST_DISTANCE(zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833)) < 5 * 1609.344
),
tracts AS (
  SELECT geo_id, tract_geom, ST_AREA(tract_geom) AS tract_area
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington`
),
tract_data AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, income_per_capita, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '53%'
),
intersections AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    t.geo_id,
    td.total_pop,
    td.income_per_capita,
    td.median_income,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) AS overlap_area,
    t.tract_area
  FROM zip_5mi z
  JOIN tracts t ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
  JOIN tract_data td ON t.geo_id = td.geo_id
  WHERE ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) > 0
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(total_pop * (overlap_area / tract_area)), 0) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(income_per_capita * total_pop * (overlap_area / tract_area)),
              SUM(total_pop * (overlap_area / tract_area))), 1) AS avg_individual_income
FROM intersections
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH 
-- 2016: births without maternal morbidity, correlated with 2015_5yr census poverty
corr_2016 AS (

  FROM (

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
    WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  ) c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE c.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births) IS NOT NULL
),

corr_2017 AS (

  ) c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id

corr_2018 AS (

    CORR(c.poverty_rate, SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births)) AS pearson_corr
  FROM (

)

WITH accident_persons AS (

WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT state_code, MAX(evaluation_group_sequence_number) as latest_seq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY state_code
),
filtered_pop AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest_eval l ON p.state_code = l.state_code AND p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = l.latest_seq
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.state_code,
    p.evaluation_group,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      ELSE 1.0
    END as adj_factor,
    p.expansion_factor,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      ELSE 1.0
    END as acres
  FROM filtered_pop p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND reserved_status_code = 0 AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as timberland_acres,
    SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as forestland_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
timberland_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
),
forestland_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 'timberland' as category, 
       CAST(t.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, 
       t.evaluation_group,
       sn.state_code_name as state_name,
       t.timberland_acres as total_acres
FROM timberland_ranked t
JOIN state_names sn ON t.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE t.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forestland' as category, 
       CAST(f.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, 
       f.evaluation_group,
       sn.state_code_name as state_name,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
  WHERE country_region = 'United States'
),
period1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2019, AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2019
  FROM filtered
  WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01'
),
period2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2020, AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2020
  FROM filtered
  WHERE date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  'United States' AS country,
  p1.avg_anxiety_2019,
  p1.avg_depression_2019,
  p2.avg_anxiety_2020,
  p2.avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2.avg_anxiety_2020 - p1.avg_anxiety_2019, p1.avg_anxiety_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_anxiety,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2.avg_depression_2020 - p1.avg_depression_2019, p1.avg_depression_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_depression
FROM period1 p1, period2 p2

SELECT 
  (COUNT(DISTINCT v.facility_place_id) * 1000.0) / (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%') as vaccine_sites_per_1000
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` v
WHERE v.facility_sub_region_1 = 'California'

WITH strategy_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN 'feeling_lucky'
         WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN 'momentum'
         ELSE 'other'
    END as strategy,
    AVG((StrikePrice - LastPx) * Quantity) as avg_intrinsic_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`, 
       UNNEST(Sides) AS s
  WHERE (TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' OR TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%')
    AND Side = 'LONG'
  GROUP BY strategy
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN strategy = 'feeling_lucky' THEN avg_intrinsic_value END) -
  MAX(CASE WHEN strategy = 'momentum' THEN avg_intrinsic_value END) as difference
FROM strategy_avg

WITH small_contributions AS (
  SELECT cmte_id, SUM(transaction_amt) as total_small_donations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.individuals_2016`
  WHERE transaction_amt > 0 AND transaction_amt < 200
  GROUP BY cmte_id
  HAVING SUM(transaction_amt) > 0
),
committees_with_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.cmte_id, cc.cand_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_committee_2016` cc
),
qualifying_committees AS (
  SELECT sc.cmte_id, sc.total_small_donations
  FROM small_contributions sc
  INNER JOIN committees_with_candidates cwc ON sc.cmte_id = cwc.cmte_id
),
committee_candidate_counts AS (
  SELECT qc.cmte_id, qc.total_small_donations, COUNT(DISTINCT cwc.cand_id) as num_candidates
  FROM qualifying_committees qc
  JOIN committees_with_candidates cwc ON qc.cmte_id = cwc.cmte_id
  GROUP BY qc.cmte_id, qc.total_small_donations
),
candidate_names AS (
  SELECT cwc.cmte_id, STRING_AGG(cand.cand_name, ',' ORDER BY cand.cand_name) as candidate_names
  FROM committees_with_candidates cwc
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_2016` cand ON cwc.cand_id = cand.cand_id
  WHERE cand.cand_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cwc.cmte_id
),
committee_names AS (
  SELECT cmte_id, cmte_nm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_2016`
)
SELECT 
  cn.cmte_nm as committee_name,
  ccc.num_candidates,
  can.candidate_names,
  ccc.total_small_donations
FROM committee_candidate_counts ccc
LEFT JOIN candidate_names can ON ccc.cmte_id = can.cmte_id
LEFT JOIN committee_names cn ON ccc.cmte_id = cn.cmte_id
ORDER BY ccc.cmte_id

SELECT

  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2012,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2017-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2017,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips` 
WHERE GeoName LIKE '%, MA' AND Year IN ('2012-01-01', '2017-01-01')
GROUP BY GeoName
ORDER BY increase ASC

SELECT 
  tz.borough AS pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount = 0 OR SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount = 0 OR SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 AS no_tip_percentage
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
  ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
WHERE DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
  AND DATE(t.dropoff_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
  AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
  AND t.passenger_count > 0
  AND t.trip_distance >= 0
  AND t.tip_amount >= 0
  AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
  AND t.mta_tax >= 0
  AND t.fare_amount >= 0
  AND t.total_amount >= 0
GROUP BY tz.borough
ORDER BY tz.borough

SELECT DISTINCT v.start_position FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v2_1_1_exomes__chr17` v CROSS JOIN UNNEST(v.alternate_bases) ab, UNNEST(ab.vep) vep WHERE v.reference_name = '17' AND v.reference_bases = 'C' AND ab.alt = 'T' AND vep.SYMBOL = 'BRCA1' AND vep.Consequence = 'missense_variant' ORDER BY v.start_position

WITH variants AS (
  SELECT 
    reference_name,
    start_position,
    end_position,
    AN,
    alternate_bases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1' 
    AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND end_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
),
variant_counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as num_variants, SUM(AN) as total_AN FROM variants
),
allele_counts AS (
  SELECT SUM(ab.AC) as total_AC 
  FROM variants, UNNEST(variants.alternate_bases) ab
),
gene_symbols AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT vep.SYMBOL) as distinct_genes
  FROM variants, UNNEST(variants.alternate_bases) ab, UNNEST(ab.vep) vep
  WHERE vep.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL AND vep.SYMBOL != ''
),
region_info AS (
  SELECT 55064852 - 55039447 as region_length
)
SELECT 
  vc.num_variants,
  vc.total_AN as total_allele_count,
  ac.total_AC as total_alternate_allele_count,
  gs.distinct_genes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ri.region_length, vc.num_variants) as mutation_density
FROM variant_counts vc, allele_counts ac, gene_symbols gs, region_info ri

SELECT 
  d.state_number,
  sm.state_name,
  '2015' as year,
  COUNT(*) as distracted_accidents
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015` d

  ON d.state_number = sm.state_number
WHERE d.driver_distracted_by NOT IN (0, 99, 96)
GROUP BY d.state_number, sm.state_name

WITH person_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.state_number,
        p.consecutive_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) AS num_persons
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a 
        ON p.state_number = a.state_number AND p.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
    WHERE a.month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY p.state_number, p.consecutive_number
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) > 1
),
severe_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.state_number,
        p.consecutive_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) AS num_severe
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a 
        ON p.state_number = a.state_number AND p.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
    WHERE a.month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
        AND p.injury_severity = 4
    GROUP BY p.state_number, p.consecutive_number
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(CASE WHEN sc.num_severe > 1 THEN 1 END), COUNT(pc.state_number)) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM person_counts pc
LEFT JOIN severe_counts sc 
    ON pc.state_number = sc.state_number AND pc.consecutive_number = sc.consecutive_number

WITH qcew_1998 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wkly_wage
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q2` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
qcew_2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wkly_wage
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q2` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
cpi_1998 AS (
  SELECT AVG(value) as avg_cpi
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u`
  WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' AND item_name = 'All items' AND item_code = 'SA0' AND year = 1998
),
cpi_2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(value) as avg_cpi
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u`
  WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' AND item_name = 'All items' AND item_code = 'SA0' AND year = 2017
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(wage_2017 - wage_1998, wage_1998) * 100, 2) as wage_growth_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cpi_2017 - cpi_1998, cpi_1998) * 100, 2) as cpi_growth_pct,
  CASE WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(wage_2017 - wage_1998, wage_1998) > SAFE_DIVIDE(cpi_2017 - cpi_1998, cpi_1998) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as kept_pace
FROM (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage) FROM qcew_1998) as wage_1998,
    (SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage) FROM qcew_2017) as wage_2017,
    (SELECT avg_cpi FROM cpi_1998) as cpi_1998,
    (SELECT avg_cpi FROM cpi_2017) as cpi_2017
)

WITH utah_counties AS (
  SELECT 
    county_fips_code AS geoid,
    county_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
),
avg_2000 AS (
  SELECT 
    geoid,
    AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_construction_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
avg_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    geoid,
    AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_construction_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT 
  uc.county_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(a2018.avg_construction_2018 - a2000.avg_construction_2000, a2000.avg_construction_2000) * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM utah_counties uc
JOIN avg_2000 a2000 ON uc.geoid = a2000.geoid
JOIN avg_2018 a2018 ON uc.geoid = a2018.geoid
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH epa AS (
  SELECT 
    city_name,
    ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat_r2, 
    ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon_r2,
    arithmetic_mean as epa_mean
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.air_quality_annual_summary`
  WHERE parameter_name = 'Acceptable PM2.5 AQI & Speciation Mass'
    AND units_of_measure = 'Micrograms/cubic meter (LC)'
    AND year = 1990
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
),
openaq_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    city,
    ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat_r2, 
    ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon_r2,
    AVG(value) as openaq_mean
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.openaq.global_air_quality`
  WHERE pollutant = 'pm25'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timestamp) = 2020
    AND city IS NOT NULL
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY city, lat_r2, lon_r2
),
matched AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(e.city_name, o.city) as city,
    e.epa_mean,
    o.openaq_mean,
    e.epa_mean - o.openaq_mean as difference
  FROM epa e
  JOIN openaq_agg o ON e.lat_r2 = o.lat_r2 AND e.lon_r2 = o.lon_r2
)
SELECT city, 
       epa_mean,
       openaq_mean,
       difference
FROM matched
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT country_name, SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN age < 25 THEN population ELSE 0 END), SUM(population)) * 100 AS pct_under_25
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
WHERE year = 2017
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY pct_under_25 DESC

SELECT 
  s.stprba AS state,
  SUM(n.value) / 1000000000.0 AS total_revenue_billions
FROM `bigquery-public-data.sec_quarterly_financials.submission` s
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.sec_quarterly_financials.numbers` n
  ON s.submission_number = n.submission_number
WHERE s.fiscal_year = 2016
  AND s.countryba = 'US'
  AND s.stprba IS NOT NULL
  AND s.stprba != ''
  AND n.measure_tag IN ('Revenues','SalesRevenueNet','SalesRevenueGoodsNet')
  AND n.number_of_quarters = 4
GROUP BY s.stprba
ORDER BY total_revenue_billions DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, iso_time, latitude, longitude, usa_wind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND name = 'LAURA'
),
storm_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    a.rn, a.iso_time, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.usa_wind,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.rn IS NOT NULL THEN 
        ST_DISTANCE(
          ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
          ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
        ) / 1000.0
      ELSE 0
    END as segment_km
  FROM storm_points a
  LEFT JOIN storm_points b
    ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn + 1
)
SELECT 
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  SUM(segment_km) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_km
FROM storm_distances
ORDER BY rn

WITH snap_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    FIPS,
    SUM(SNAP_All_Participation_Households) as total_snap_households
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_snap_enrollment.snap_enrollment` 
  WHERE Date = '2017-01-01' AND Program = 'EBT'
  GROUP BY FIPS
  HAVING total_snap_households > 0
),
county_income AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    income_less_10000 + income_10000_14999 + income_15000_19999 as under_20k
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
),
county_names AS (
  SELECT GeoFIPS, GeoName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips`
  WHERE Year = '2017-01-01'
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT s.FIPS, s.total_snap_households
  FROM snap_counts s
  WHERE s.FIPS IN (SELECT geo_id FROM county_income)
  ORDER BY s.total_snap_households DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
  cn.GeoName as county_name,
  t.total_snap_households,
  ci.under_20k,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ci.under_20k, t.total_snap_households) as ratio_under_20k
FROM top10 t
JOIN county_income ci ON t.FIPS = ci.geo_id
JOIN county_names cn ON t.FIPS = cn.GeoFIPS
ORDER BY t.total_snap_households DESC

WITH earliest_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id,
    MIN(creation_date) as earliest_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),
question_answered AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as question_id,
    q.creation_date as question_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM q.creation_date) as dow,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%A', q.creation_date) as day_name,
    ea.earliest_answer_date,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(ea.earliest_answer_date, q.creation_date, SECOND) as seconds_to_answer
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN earliest_answers ea ON ea.parent_id = q.id
),
daily_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    day_name,
    dow,
    COUNT(*) as total_questions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN seconds_to_answer <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as answered_within_hour,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN seconds_to_answer <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)) * 100 as percentage
  FROM question_answered
  GROUP BY day_name, dow
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    day_name,
    percentage,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_stats
)
SELECT 
  day_name,
  percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 3

WITH alive_patients AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient`
  WHERE deceased IS NULL OR deceased.dateTime IS NULL
),
patients_with_diagnosis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject.patientId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition`
  WHERE code.coding[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].code IN ('40055000', '38341003')
),
patients_with_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    subject.patientId,
    COUNT(DISTINCT medication.codeableConcept.coding[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].code) as distinct_meds
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request`
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND medication.codeableConcept.coding[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].code IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT medication.codeableConcept.coding[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].code) >= 7
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as patient_count
FROM alive_patients ap
INNER JOIN patients_with_diagnosis pwd ON ap.id = pwd.patientId
INNER JOIN patients_with_meds pwm ON ap.id = pwm.patientId

SELECT

    o.artist_display_name,
    o.medium,
    i.original_image_url
FROM `bigquery-public-data.the_met.objects` o
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.the_met.images` i ON o.object_id = i.object_id

    AND o.artist_display_name != 'Unknown'
    AND o.artist_display_name != 'Unidentified Artist'

WITH daily_cases AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    state_name,
    confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY date) AS daily_new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE state_name = 'Illinois' AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31'
),
top5_daily AS (
  SELECT date, county, state_name, daily_new_cases,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY daily_new_cases DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_cases
  WHERE daily_new_cases IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY daily_new_cases DESC) <= 5
),
county_freq AS (
  SELECT county, COUNT(*) as appearance_count
  FROM top5_daily
  GROUP BY county
)
SELECT county, appearance_count
FROM county_freq
ORDER BY appearance_count DESC, county ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  za.zipcode,
  za.zipcode_geom,
  za.area_land_meters,
  za.area_water_meters,
  za.latitude,
  za.longitude,
  za.state_code,
  za.state_name,
  za.city,
  za.county,
  COALESCE(pop.total_population, 0) AS total_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    zipcode,
    SUM(population) AS total_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010`
  WHERE gender IN ('male', 'female')
  GROUP BY zipcode
) pop ON za.zipcode = pop.zipcode
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
  ST_GEOGFROM('POINT(-122.3321 47.6062)'),
  ST_GEOGFROM(za.zipcode_geom),
  10000
)
ORDER BY za.zipcode

WITH proteome_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    p.gene_symbol,
    a.sample_type,
    a.sample_submitter_id as sample_id,
    AVG(p.protein_abundance_log2ratio) as avg_protein
  FROM isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current p
  JOIN isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current a ON p.sample_id = a.sample_id
  WHERE a.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
  GROUP BY p.gene_symbol, a.sample_type, a.sample_submitter_id
),
rna_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    sample_barcode as sample_id,
    gene_name,
    sample_type_name,
    AVG(LOG(fpkm_unstranded + 1)) as avg_log_fpkm
  FROM isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current
  WHERE primary_site = 'Kidney'
    AND project_short_name = 'CPTAC-3'
    AND sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND gene_type = 'protein_coding'
  GROUP BY sample_barcode, gene_name, sample_type_name
),
joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.gene_symbol,
    p.sample_type,
    p.avg_protein,
    r.avg_log_fpkm
  FROM proteome_agg p
  JOIN rna_agg r ON p.sample_id = r.sample_id AND p.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
  WHERE p.sample_type = r.sample_type_name
),
gene_correlations AS (
  SELECT sample_type, gene_symbol, CORR(avg_protein, avg_log_fpkm) as correlation
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
  HAVING CORR(avg_protein, avg_log_fpkm) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sample_type, AVG(correlation) as avg_correlation
FROM gene_correlations
WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
GROUP BY sample_type

mutation_data AS (

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
  WHERE m.Study = 'PAAD' AND m.Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD'

patient_mutations AS (
  SELECT

    MAX(CASE WHEN md.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients pp
  LEFT JOIN mutation_data md ON pp.patient_id = md.patient_id
  WHERE pp.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM all_paad_mutation_patients)
  GROUP BY pp.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d,
    COUNT(*) as total
  FROM patient_mutations
),
chi_squared_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    a, b, c, d, total,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(a - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d))) 
    + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(b - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)))
    + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(c - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d)))
    + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(d - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)))
    as chi_squared_statistic
  FROM contingency
)
SELECT chi_squared_statistic FROM chi_squared_calc

-- Calculate the net difference: patients with both KRAS and TP53 mutations minus patients with neither
WITH kras_pass AS (

    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`

both_mutations AS (

    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level2_metadata_r5` l2
    INNER JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` l2_prov

    AND l2_prov.Component IS NOT NULL
    AND l2_prov.Component NOT LIKE '%Auxiliary%'
    AND l2_prov.Component NOT LIKE '%OtherAssay%'

WITH station_stats AS (

              AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`

  GROUP BY stn
),

),

  FROM station_stats 
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, total_days) >= 0.90
)
SELECT

INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id

  AND t.data_file_year = 2016
  AND (t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-02-01 00:00:00') AND t.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-02-08 00:00:00'))
  AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
  AND t.passenger_count > 3
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10
  AND pz.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND dz.borough = 'Brooklyn'

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_desc

      ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-73.764 41.197)'),
      32186.88
    )

temp_counts AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`

    ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-73.764 41.197)')

WITH yearly_sales AS (

  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2022, 2023)
    AND sale_dollars > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2022 THEN total_revenue END) AS revenue_2022,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2023 THEN total_revenue END) AS revenue_2023
  FROM yearly_sales
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  ROUND(revenue_2022, 2) AS revenue_2022,
  ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue_2023 - revenue_2022, revenue_2022) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_pct

ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC

WITH plot_sizes AS (

    CASE WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN 'subplot' ELSE 'macroplot' END AS plot_type,

      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      ELSE 0
    END AS plot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
state_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    inventory_year,
    plot_type,
    AVG(plot_size) AS avg_plot_size
  FROM plot_sizes
  GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year, plot_type
)
SELECT 
  plot_type,
  inventory_year,
  state_code,
  avg_plot_size
FROM state_avg
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plot_type, inventory_year ORDER BY avg_plot_size DESC) = 1
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year

WITH user_first_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_last_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MAX(date) AS last_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_first_transaction AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_transaction_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
       UNNEST(hits) AS hit
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_first_transaction_device AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date, deviceCategory
  FROM (
    SELECT fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory AS deviceCategory,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
         UNNEST(hits) AS hit
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
      AND hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
user_last_visit_device AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date, deviceCategory
  FROM (
    SELECT fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory AS deviceCategory,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    fv.fullVisitorId,
    fv.first_visit_date,
    lv.last_visit_date,
    ft.first_transaction_date,
    lvd.deviceCategory AS last_visit_device,
    ftd.deviceCategory AS first_transaction_device,
    CASE 
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date IS NULL THEN lv.last_visit_date
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date > lv.last_visit_date THEN ft.first_transaction_date
      ELSE lv.last_visit_date
    END AS last_event_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date IS NULL THEN 'last_visit'
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date > lv.last_visit_date THEN 'first_transaction'
      ELSE 'last_visit'
    END AS last_event_type
  FROM user_first_visit fv
  JOIN user_last_visit lv ON fv.fullVisitorId = lv.fullVisitorId
  LEFT JOIN user_first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
  LEFT JOIN user_last_visit_device lvd ON fv.fullVisitorId = lvd.fullVisitorId
  LEFT JOIN user_first_transaction_device ftd ON fv.fullVisitorId = ftd.fullVisitorId
),
user_last_event_device AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    first_visit_date,
    last_event_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN last_event_type = 'last_visit' THEN last_visit_device
      WHEN last_event_type = 'first_transaction' THEN first_transaction_device
    END AS last_event_device_category
  FROM user_events
)
SELECT 
  MAX(DATE_DIFF(
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', last_event_date),
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_visit_date),
    DAY
  )) AS max_days
FROM user_last_event_device
WHERE last_event_device_category = 'mobile'

-- Final approach: use ST_WITHIN with buffer based on r34 values
SELECT p.port_name, COUNT(*) as appearance_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_international_ports.world_port_index` p
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.states` s
  ON ST_WITHIN(p.port_geom, s.state_geom)
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
  ON ST_WITHIN(p.port_geom, ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(h.usa_longitude, h.usa_latitude), 
    GREATEST(COALESCE(h.usa_r34_ne, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_se, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_sw, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_nw, 0)) * 1852))
WHERE p.region_number = '6585'
  AND h.basin = 'NA'
  AND h.name != 'NOT_NAMED'
  AND h.usa_wind >= 35
  AND (h.usa_r34_ne IS NOT NULL OR h.usa_r34_se IS NOT NULL OR h.usa_r34_sw IS NOT NULL OR h.usa_r34_nw IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY p.port_name
ORDER BY appearance_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH census AS (

    AVG(percent_qualified) as avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) as total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) as total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) as energy_generation,

    SUM(existing_installs_count) as current_installs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_censustract`
  GROUP BY state_name
),
postal AS (
  SELECT
    state_name,
    'postal_code' as level,
    SUM(count_qualified) as total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) as avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) as avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) as total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) as total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) as energy_generation,
    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) as carbon_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) as current_installs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_postal_code`
  GROUP BY state_name
)
SELECT
  state_name,
  level,
  total_buildings,
  ROUND(avg_percent_covered, 2) as avg_percent_covered,
  ROUND(avg_percent_qualified, 2) as avg_percent_qualified,
  total_panels,
  ROUND(total_kw, 2) as total_kw,
  ROUND(energy_generation, 2) as energy_generation,
  ROUND(carbon_offset, 2) as carbon_offset,
  current_installs,
  ROUND(total_buildings * SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_percent_covered, 100) * SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_percent_qualified, 100) - current_installs, 2) as gap_potential_installations
FROM census
UNION ALL
SELECT
  state_name,
  level,
  total_buildings,
  ROUND(avg_percent_covered, 2) as avg_percent_covered,
  ROUND(avg_percent_qualified, 2) as avg_percent_qualified,
  total_panels,
  ROUND(total_kw, 2) as total_kw,
  ROUND(energy_generation, 2) as energy_generation,
  ROUND(carbon_offset, 2) as carbon_offset,
  current_installs,
  ROUND(total_buildings * SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_percent_covered, 100) * SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_percent_qualified, 100) - current_installs, 2) as gap_potential_installations
FROM postal
ORDER BY state_name, level

    AND gs.min_temp != 9999.9 AND gs.min_temp IS NOT NULL

),

),
all_dates AS (

WITH 
-- All NY zip codes
ny_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
-- All 24 hours
hours AS (
  SELECT * FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) AS hour_of_day
),
-- Cross join to get all zip_code x hour combinations
grid AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour_of_day
  FROM ny_zips z
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),
-- Trips on Jan 1, 2015 with zip codes via ST_CONTAINS
jan1_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) AS hour_of_day,
    z.zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z 
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE DATE(t.pickup_datetime) = '2015-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
),
-- Count trips per zip_code per hour on Jan 1
hourly_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM jan1_trips
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour_of_day
),
-- For lookback: 1 hour ago = previous hour count
prev_hour AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour_of_day, total_trips as trips_1hr_ago
  FROM hourly_counts
),
-- Base grid with counts
base AS (
  SELECT 
    g.zip_code,
    g.hour_of_day,
    COALESCE(hc.total_trips, 0) as total_trips,
    COALESCE(ph.trips_1hr_ago, 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
    0 as trips_1day_ago,
    0 as trips_7day_ago,
    0 as trips_14day_ago
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc 
    ON g.zip_code = hc.zip_code AND g.hour_of_day = hc.hour_of_day
  LEFT JOIN prev_hour ph 
    ON g.zip_code = ph.zip_code AND g.hour_of_day = ph.hour_of_day + 1
),
-- 14-hour moving avg (excluding current hour)
moving_avg_14 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    AVG(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_avg_14day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 14
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
),
-- 14-hour std dev
moving_std_14 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    STDDEV(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_std_14day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 14
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
),
-- 21-hour moving avg (excluding current hour)
moving_avg_21 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    AVG(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_avg_21day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 21
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
),
-- 21-hour std dev
moving_std_21 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    STDDEV(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_std_21day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 21
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
)
SELECT 
  b.zip_code,
  b.hour_of_day,
  b.total_trips,
  b.trips_1hr_ago,
  b.trips_1day_ago,
  b.trips_7day_ago,
  b.trips_14day_ago,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ma14.moving_avg_14day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_14day,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ms14.moving_std_14day, 0), 2) as moving_std_14day,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ma21.moving_avg_21day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_21day,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ms21.moving_std_21day, 0), 2) as moving_std_21day
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN moving_avg_14 ma14 ON b.zip_code = ma14.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ma14.hour_of_day
LEFT JOIN moving_std_14 ms14 ON b.zip_code = ms14.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ms14.hour_of_day
LEFT JOIN moving_avg_21 ma21 ON b.zip_code = ma21.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ma21.hour_of_day
LEFT JOIN moving_std_21 ms21 ON b.zip_code = ms21.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ms21.hour_of_day
ORDER BY b.total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH 
-- Get question owners
question_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    owner_user_id AS user_id,
    id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
),

-- Get accepted answerers
accepted_answerers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pa.id = pq.accepted_answer_id
),

-- Get answers with score > 5
high_score_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.score > 5
),

-- Get total score per question for the 20% rule
question_total_scores AS (
  SELECT
    parent_id AS question_id,
    SUM(score) AS total_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),

-- Get answers exceeding 20% of total score and score > 0
high_pct_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN question_total_scores qts ON pa.parent_id = qts.question_id
  WHERE pa.score > 0 
    AND CAST(pa.score AS FLOAT64) > 0.2 * CAST(qts.total_score AS FLOAT64)
),

-- Get top 3 highest-scoring answers per question
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    pa.score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.parent_id ORDER BY pa.score DESC, pa.id ASC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
),

top3_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_id,
    question_id
  FROM ranked_answers
  WHERE rn <= 3
),

-- Combine all associated user-question pairs
associated_users AS (
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM question_owners
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM accepted_answerers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM high_score_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM high_pct_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM top3_answers
),

-- Deduplicate (same user-question pair from multiple criteria)
distinct_associations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, question_id FROM associated_users
)

-- Join with questions to get view counts, aggregate by user
SELECT 
  da.user_id,
  u.display_name,
  SUM(pq.view_count) AS combined_view_count
FROM distinct_associations da
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON da.question_id = pq.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON da.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY da.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY combined_view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

  WHERE DATE(end_date) >= '2017-01-01' AND DATE(end_date) < '2018-01-01'
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE 0 END) AS customer_minutes,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_data
  GROUP BY 1
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    am.month_num,
    COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0) AS customer_minutes,
    COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM all_months am
  LEFT JOIN pivoted p ON am.month_num = p.month_num
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  ROUND(ABS(customer_minutes - subscriber_minutes), 3) AS abs_diff_in_thousands
FROM joined
ORDER BY month_num

WITH minute_values AS (

  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL

  SELECT duration_minutes,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY duration_minutes) as ntile_group
  FROM minute_values

  tw.ntile_group,

WITH user_activity AS (

  GROUP BY `by`, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH)
),
user_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(activity_month) as first_month,
    MAX(activity_month) as last_month
  FROM user_activity
  GROUP BY user_id
),
month_series AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,

    last_month,
    DATE_ADD(first_month, INTERVAL n MONTH) as month_num,
    n + 1 as month_number
  FROM user_spans,
  UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, DATE_DIFF(DATE('2024-09-01'), first_month, MONTH))) as n
),
gap_months AS (
  SELECT

    ms.month_num,

  FROM month_series ms
  LEFT JOIN user_activity ua ON ms.user_id = ua.user_id AND ms.month_num = ua.activity_month

),
first_gap AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,

    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst

  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL

  SELECT

    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,

  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,

    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,

    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,

    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,

WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID as uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157

    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
all_tas_uniprot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ppe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON ppe.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  WHERE ppe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
non_targets AS (
  SELECT uniprot_id FROM all_tas_uniprot
  EXCEPT DISTINCT
  SELECT uniprot_id FROM sorafenib_targets
),
pathway_tas_uniprot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ppe.pathway_stable_id, pe.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ppe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON ppe.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  WHERE ppe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
lowest_pathways AS (
  SELECT stable_id, name
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77`
  WHERE lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    lp.stable_id as pathway_id,
    lp.name as pathway_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.uniprot_id IN (SELECT uniprot_id FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN pt.uniprot_id END) as a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT uniprot_id FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN pt.uniprot_id END) as c
  FROM lowest_pathways lp
  JOIN pathway_tas_uniprot pt ON lp.stable_id = pt.pathway_stable_id
  GROUP BY lp.stable_id, lp.name
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sorafenib_targets) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM non_targets) as total_non_targets
),
with_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.*,
    t.total_targets,
    t.total_non_targets,
    t.total_targets - pc.a as b,
    t.total_non_targets - pc.c as d,
    pc.a + (t.total_targets - pc.a) + pc.c + (t.total_non_targets - pc.c) as n
  FROM pathway_counts pc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  pathway_id,
  pathway_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(a*d - b*c, 2) * n, (a+b) * (c+d) * (a+c) * (b+d)) as chi_squared,
  a as targets_within,
  b as targets_outside,
  c as non_targets_within,
  d as non_targets_outside
FROM with_counts
WHERE a > 0
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
