    COUNT(*) as act_count,
    SUM(CAST(potential_duplicate AS INT64)) as dup_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING act_count < 5 AND dup_count < 2
),
qual_activities AS (
  SELECT q.*
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN mol_counts mc ON q.assay_id = mc.assay_id 
    AND q.standard_type = mc.standard_type
    AND q.molregno = mc.molregno
),
doc_info AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    journal,
    year,
    first_page,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) as pr
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) as yr,
    GREATEST(1, CAST(FLOOR(pr * 11) AS INT64) + 1) as mo,
    CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(pr * 308) AS INT64), 28) AS INT64) + 1 as dy,
    CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) AS STRING), '-', 
      LPAD(CAST(GREATEST(1, CAST(FLOOR(pr * 11) AS INT64) + 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', 
      LPAD(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(pr * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0')) as pub_date
  FROM doc_info
),
act_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    qa.*,
    dd.yr,
    dd.mo,
    dd.dy,
    dd.pub_date
  FROM qual_activities qa
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd ON qa.doc_id = dd.doc_id
),
-- Get distinct pairs
pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    q1.assay_id, 
    q1.standard_type, 
    q1.molregno as molregno_1, 
    q2.molregno as molregno_2
  FROM qual_activities q1
  JOIN qual_activities q2 ON q1.assay_id = q2.assay_id 
    AND q1.standard_type = q2.standard_type
    AND q1.molregno < q2.molregno
),
-- For each pair, get the molecule properties
mol_props AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molregno, heavy_atoms, canonical_smiles
  FROM qual_activities
),
-- For each pair, compute the required aggregations
pair_details AS (
  SELECT 
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    p.molregno_1,
    p.molregno_2,
    GREATEST(mp1.heavy_atoms, mp2.heavy_atoms) as max_heavy_atoms,
    GREATEST(MAX(ad1.pub_date), MAX(ad2.pub_date)) as latest_pub_date,
    GREATEST(MAX(ad1.doc_id), MAX(ad2.doc_id)) as highest_doc_id,
    MAX(SAFE_CAST(ad1.standard_value AS FLOAT64)) as max_std_val_1,
    MAX(SAFE_CAST(ad2.standard_value AS FLOAT64)) as max_std_val_2,
    mp1.canonical_smiles as smiles_1,
    mp2.canonical_smiles as smiles_2,
    MIN(ad1.activity_id) as act_id_1,
    MIN(ad2.activity_id) as act_id_2
  FROM pairs p
  JOIN mol_props mp1 ON p.molregno_1 = mp1.molregno
  JOIN mol_props mp2 ON p.molregno_2 = mp2.molregno
  JOIN act_with_dates ad1 ON p.molregno_1 = ad1.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = ad1.assay_id AND p.standard_type = ad1.standard_type
  JOIN act_with_dates ad2 ON p.molregno_2 = ad2.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = ad2.assay_id AND p.standard_type = ad2.standard_type
  GROUP BY p.assay_id, p.standard_type, p.molregno_1, p.molregno_2, mp1.heavy_atoms, mp2.heavy_atoms, mp1.canonical_smiles, mp2.canonical_smiles
)
SELECT 
  pd.max_heavy_atoms,
  pd.latest_pub_date,
  pd.highest_doc_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN pd.max_std_val_1 > pd.max_std_val_2 THEN 'decrease'
    WHEN pd.max_std_val_1 < pd.max_std_val_2 THEN 'increase'
    ELSE 'no-change'
  END as std_change,
  TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(pd.act_id_1, pd.act_id_2)))) as mmp_delta_uuid
FROM pair_details pd
ORDER BY pd.assay_id, pd.molregno_1, pd.molregno_2

user_pageviews AS (

WITH first_sessions AS (

    MIN(event_date) as first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20180917'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohort_info AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), WEEK(MONDAY)) as cohort_monday
  FROM first_sessions
),
week2_range AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    cohort_monday,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_monday, INTERVAL 14 DAY) as week2_start,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_monday, INTERVAL 20 DAY) as week2_end
  FROM cohort_info
),
week2_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    e.user_pseudo_id,
    wr.cohort_monday
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  JOIN week2_range wr ON e.user_pseudo_id = wr.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180723' AND '20181007'
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND e.event_date >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', wr.week2_start)
    AND e.event_date <= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', wr.week2_end)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', wr.cohort_monday) as cohort_date,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT ws.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT wr.user_pseudo_id)) as week2_retention_rate
FROM week2_range wr
LEFT JOIN week2_sessions ws 
  ON wr.user_pseudo_id = ws.user_pseudo_id 
  AND wr.cohort_monday = ws.cohort_monday
GROUP BY wr.cohort_monday
ORDER BY wr.cohort_monday

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102` e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
),
with_segments AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS segments
  FROM page_views
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    segments,
    CASE 
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5 THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) - 1)], ''), r'\+')
            AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(3)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')
              OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(4)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)'))
          THEN 'PDP'
          WHEN NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(segments[OFFSET(3)], ''), r'\+')
            AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(segments[OFFSET(4)], ''), r'\+')
            AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(3)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')
              OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(4)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)'))
          THEN 'PLP'
          ELSE 'other'
        END
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS page_type
  FROM with_segments
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_page_views,
  SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PDP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pdp_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PLP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as plp_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'other' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as other_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PDP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as pdp_percentage
FROM classified

WITH purchase_users AS (

page_views AS (

    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
user_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.cohort_monday,
    DATE_DIFF(DATE_SUB(us.session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM us.session_date) - 2) DAY), c.cohort_monday, WEEK) AS week_offset
  FROM cohorts c
  JOIN user_sessions us ON c.user_pseudo_id = us.user_pseudo_id
),
retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_monday,
    user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN week_offset = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_week_4
  FROM user_weeks
  GROUP BY cohort_monday, user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT cohort_monday
FROM retention_check
GROUP BY cohort_monday
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(returned_week_4), COUNT(*)) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT IFNULL(p.value.int_value, -1)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) p
     WHERE p.key = 'ga_session_id') as session_id,
    (SELECT IFNULL(p.value.string_value, '')
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) p
     WHERE p.key = 'page_title') as page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '20210102'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
sessions_with_home AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id
  FROM page_views
  WHERE page_title = 'Home'
),
sessions_with_checkout AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id
  FROM page_views
  WHERE page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT sh.session_id) as home_sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) as checkout_sessions,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sh.session_id)) * 100 as conversion_rate
FROM sessions_with_home sh
LEFT JOIN sessions_with_checkout sc ON sh.session_id = sc.session_id

WITH events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
prep AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS segs,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS n
  FROM events
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    segs[OFFSET(3)] AS seg4,
    segs[OFFSET(4)] AS seg5,
    segs[OFFSET(n-1)] AS last_seg,
    n AS total_segments,
    CASE
      WHEN n >= 5 
           AND (LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
                OR LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(segs[OFFSET(n-1)], r'\+')
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN n >= 5 
           AND (LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
                OR LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(segs[OFFSET(n-1)], r'\+')
      THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_title
  FROM prep
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    display_title,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM classified
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    display_title,
    rn,
    rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY display_title ORDER BY rn) AS grp
  FROM numbered
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(rn) AS first_rn,
    display_title
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY display_title, grp
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' AS user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>' ORDER BY first_rn) AS navigation_flow
FROM merged
